summary: Improves dynamic-modal chrome and persistent actions, and surfaces disconnected or revoked Control Panel links.
highlights: New 'Disconnected' state and warning banner on the Control Panel, distinct from a never-configured one, naming the control URL and whether it was revoked.
The update worker posts a one-time warning notification to superadmins when a connected deployment is disconnected or revoked (re-armed on reconnect).
Dynamic modals now show one shell title and keep submit, cancel, and wizard controls in the visible footer.
Fixed the global footer overlapping modal action bars (submit buttons) — it now steps out while any modal is open.

New UI & Layout toggles: show audit fields (created/updated by/at) in every table and via the new {% dlux_audit_trail %} detail block (gated by the view_audit_fields permission), and show soft-deleted entries (superadmin only).
